headline: Last session: Sensex jumped 898 points, Nifty reclaimed 25,800 led by banking stocks and foreign inflows.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Banking stocks led a strong market rally during the previous trading session.
Foreign inflows boosted investor sentiment and lifted domestic indices.
Sensex surged 898 points, defying sell-offs seen in global markets.
Nifty Bank reached a record high level during Friday's trading session.
whatHappening: Sensex jumped 898 points while Nifty50 ended at 25,801 on the last trading day.
Apollo Hospitals emerged as a top gainer on the Nifty50 index.
IRDAI imposed a penalty of ₹2 crore on Star Health.
US markets fell and Nasdaq turned negative for 2026 amid rate hike signals and tech sell-offs.
summary:
On the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices rallied strongly with Sensex surging 898 points and Nifty closing at 25,801.
The gains were powered by banking stocks and robust foreign inflows, lifting Nifty Bank to a fresh record high.
Among individual stocks, Apollo Hospitals led the market gainers while Star Health faced a ₹2 crore regulatory penalty.
